title: Jesus, Why Does Everyone Else's Life Look So Much Better?

bible.text: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why does everyone else's life look so much better than mine online?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're comparing your everyday to their highlight reel. You're not seeing the whole story -- just the part they chose to show.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But I still feel like I'm falling behind everyone.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You were never made to be her. You were made to be exactly who I formed you to be.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: When do you feel the pressure to compare the most?
